purpose: Teach: 脳死/永続/双方向/包囲/落選/兵力/没収/上告

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、脳死関連の医療事業に参入しろ
lines.en: I want us to enter the brain-death medical sector.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with quiet certainty. No rising inflection—statement, not question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。永続的な顧客との関係を維持します
lines.en: Understood. We'll maintain continuity with our partners.
lines.style: Respectful but assured. Slight forward lean. Steady voice—he's already thinking through the logistics. Professional, not deferential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、双方向のサービスを開発しろ
lines.en: Develop a bidirectional service model for us.
lines.style: Clipped, purposeful. Light stress on 'develop.' He's setting the standard, not asking for input. Brief pause before the next thought lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の包囲戦略を立案中です
lines.en: Understood. We're currently mapping out a market encirclement strategy.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Speaking from notes or a plan in his head. Even pacing. Confidence comes from preparation, not volume.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、入札で落選しても撤退するな
lines.en: Don't retreat if we lose a bid. Hold the position.
lines.style: Firm, almost conversational in its bluntness. Eyes narrowed slightly. The tone of someone who's seen people panic and quit too early.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外現法の兵力規模に近い体制を整えます
lines.en: Understood. We're building our overseas subsidiary to match that scale.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. He's already visualizing the structure. No hesitation. The tone of someone confirming what's already been decided.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不正所得の没収命令には従え
lines.en: Comply with any forfeiture orders on illicit gains.
lines.style: Quiet but unambiguous. He's not debating ethics—he's stating necessity. A slight exhale on 'comply,' like closing a file.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。係争中の案件は上告審へ進みます
lines.en: Understood. We're appealing the disputed cases to the higher court.
lines.style: Composed, final. He's wrapping up. Short, assured sentences. The tone of someone who has learned when to stop fighting and when to fight harder.
